question: Is a rest period of nine hours between two shifts acceptable?

final.answer: No. A nine-hour rest between two shifts is not acceptable: the department rule (Rule 1) and ArbZG § 5(1) require at least 11 hours of uninterrupted rest between duties.

served: No. A nine-hour rest between two shifts is not acceptable: the department rule (Rule 1) and ArbZG § 5(1) require at least 11 hours of uninterrupted rest between duties.

Question:
Is a rest period of nine hours between two shifts acceptable?

blocks.text: Rule 1 of the department rulebook and ArbZG § 5(1) both require at least 11 hours of uninterrupted rest between duties. A nine-hour rest is therefore below the minimum and not acceptable. (§ 7(3) allows a reduction of up to two hours only under a collective agreement and with compensation, which would still leave nine hours below the limit unless that framework applies; I have not checked that, so I am not relying on it.)

input.answer: No. A nine-hour rest between two shifts is not acceptable: the department rule (Rule 1) and ArbZG § 5(1) require at least 11 hours of uninterrupted rest between duties.
